query: Murcia Spain taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Starting price of a taxi in Murcia is EUR 3.0, each km priced at EUR 1.5. Alternate source: fares start between EUR 2.40-2.99 with EUR 0.97-1.22 per km depending on time of day. Over 18km trips pay per-km; under 18km pay per-minute for app-based rides.
